summary: Keep native work lease polling independent of timing history and list presentation

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay changes.

schema.detail: Uses the existing held-step lease index; no persisted schema changes.

rules.detail: Preserves current owner, generation, lease and harness-incarnation checks and writer-side renewal validation.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/work accepts view=renewal with a required actor and returns only currently held claimed/working/verifying/blocked steps selected by the driver's shared held-claim predicate, without timing, queue, wake, summaries or hierarchy enrichment. Native renewal polling selects this view. The default full list is unchanged. Fixed performance labels distinguish work/renewal, work/list and named native diagnostic, timeline, wait and subagent callers.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores full-list native polling without changing durable state.
